milestones.title: Codex vertical slice and fleet
milestones.decision: Codex implementation is Intermediate, with discovery, safety correction, implementation, and service-transition evidence recorded. The first three corrective rollovers preserved the completed 6bfa69dc13cc9e1ded9c6baa6e803cb99bc8c20b, 063445154bca0bf5ec43db94ba57c17fd193fd99, and 6d6e1aa9d9b64d50e3f83d0f1686e6cff04b7c17 transitions in their fixed private archives, and the required third-rollover rerun activated exact revision e066d7e1ba0124f0454c07002ea7b2ad0817d6b9 with real systemd, HTTP, authenticated-browser, Registry, database, rollback, and receipt proof. AUTO-M5-OWNER-OUTCOMES is current for that service with four total outcomes: three verified and one owner-unavailable; three fresh genuine collections and the paginated current/history regression also passed. A genuine alert completed opening or reopening, repeat, owner action, recovery, API and browser presentation, and the old browser child emitted one valid proof document but retained its CDP connection, so AUTO-M5-ALERT-WITNESS blocked and wrote no witness. Under approved focused plan 1.8.0, the P02 policy suite passed 65 tests; responsive, revocation, and password change each passed 30 consecutive first-attempt isolated real-stack runs; the complete P02 all, security_boundary, and hostile_resource lanes passed; focused M5 automation passed 55 tests; UI policy passed 16 tests; independent reviews were CLEAN; and AUTO-QUALITY and AUTO-BUILD passed. Complete AUTO-TEST attempt one retained a real Argon2 p95 failure of 0.27936251898063347 seconds at the 0.25-second ceiling under load average 32.08; the focused low-contention Argon2 run then passed 2 tests. Attempt two passed 1361 backend tests but retained a P02 browser_output_invalid failure because an out-of-scope systemd wrapper could not access the user bus in the PATH/PYTHONPATH-only environment. The scope audit restored the approved direct-child runner, rejected process-level return codes 2, 127 and -9, and admitted one allowlisted failure line only at exact code 1. Final runner blobs are 8afd41102d0168ac4a0a5934a591ede69804cc60 and 96083d23627c015a26bbfd154bb7ca37e5de5496; independent review was CLEAN with no P0/P1/P2. The final AUTO-TEST passed operationally with 104 command tests, 2 Argon2 tests, 1361 passed/37 skipped/1 warning backend, compatible 67-operation OpenAPI, production build, 2 foundation browser tests, and complete P02/security/hostile-resource lanes. The temporary exact Claude process and private root were safely removed after the pass. A clean candidate, live fourth rollover, refreshed prerequisites, official quota, process, containment, clean exact-revision AUTO-M5-EXIT run, and owner acceptance remain Not Run or Blocked as recorded. The canonical gate state remains not_run.
